results.question: Does Cosmo's 2026 checkup prove there have never been any health problems?
required: That note says no new diagnosis was entered

results.answer:
No.
Cosmo’s 2026 annual examination records no new diagnosis and no medication prescribed, and it explicitly says that this does not establish lifetime absence of illness or unrecorded care.
A later mobility note records one hesitation before stepping onto the usual low platform with the cause and onset not recorded, followed four days later by a normal step-up check, so the record does not prove there have never been any health problems.
